clue.text: Condescend to accept sec-end plan

indicators.note: to accept means one piece takes the other in, so the verb for condescending is opened up

parts.note: to condescend is to deign
S is the standard abbreviation for second

explanation.surface: Someone graciously agrees to take on a back-up plan.
explanation.walkthrough: The scan's 'sec-end' is a line-break misreading of 'second'. 'to accept' puts S inside DEIGN.
explanation.definitionFit: A design is a scheme or intention, as in doing something by design.

clue.text: Gloomy, but with scope for development

definitions.text: Gloomy, but with scope for development

parts.words: Gloomy, but with scope for development
parts.note: an unlit space where photographic film can be developed, read as a place of potential

explanation.definitionFit: Photographers process film in a windowless, unlit chamber so light cannot spoil it.

clue.text: Fed lines into position required for space station

indicators.note: into means the first pieces go inside the word for a location

parts.note: a site is a position or location
fed means ate, as in he fed on bread
L is the abbreviation for line, so LL is lines

explanation.surface: Instructions for feeding cables into place for an orbiting base.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fed' looks like part of the surface's feeding of cables, but it is the past tense of eat; 'into' places the pieces inside the word for position.
explanation.definitionFit: A satellite is an artificial body orbiting the Earth, such as a manned orbital station.

clue.text: Determination shown by Greece and Italy

parts.note: GR is the international code for Greece

explanation.surface: Two Mediterranean nations show resolve.
explanation.definitionFit: Grit is courage and resolve in the face of hardship.

clue.text: Throw a small house together

parts.note: to bung is informal British for to throw or toss
low can mean small, as in a low number or low stature

explanation.surface: An instruction to knock up a modest home in a hurry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Throw together' reads as a phrase for building hastily, but 'together' only links the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A bungalow is a one-storey dwelling, a type of home.

clue.text: Leading Conservative is standing

parts.note: up means ahead, as in two goals up
the right is the conservative side of politics

explanation.surface: A top Tory has kept their seat.
explanation.definitionFit: Upright means vertical, on one's feet.

clue.text: It's assumed said residence provides travellers' accommodation

indicators.note: said means the word for assumed is spoken, giving a sound-alike

parts.note: assumed means guessed
a house is a residence

explanation.surface: A grand home is thought to offer rooms to visitors.
explanation.definitionFit: A guesthouse is a private home offering paid lodging to visitors.

clue.text: Heather goes over old language

indicators.note: goes over means, in a down answer, the plant word sits above the next piece

parts.note: ling is a common heather

explanation.surface: Moorland plants spread over an ancient tongue.
explanation.definitionFit: Lingo is an informal word for a language or jargon.

clue.text: Weaker individuals initially led astray by school exercises

indicators.note: initially means take the first letters of the next two words
astray means the three letters wander out of order

explanation.surface: Weaklings get misled by a school's physical training regime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'astray' turns LED into ELD; 'by' adds S.
explanation.definitionFit: To wield power is to exercise it.

clue.text: Approach area in front of meeting place

indicators.note: in front of means the first piece comes before the second

parts.note: a venue is a place where events or meetings are held

explanation.surface: Directions to a conference centre.
explanation.definitionFit: An avenue is a broad road or approach, also a line of approach to a problem.

clue.text: Tree and river confused hunter's dog

indicators.note: confused tells us the letters of the two words are jumbled together

explanation.surface: A dog bewildered by a tree and a river while out hunting.
explanation.definitionFit: A retriever is a gun dog bred to fetch shot game for hunters.

clue.text: E is joining the Navy that's the boy!

parts.note: RN is the Royal Navy
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: Someone called E signs up for the Navy, to cheers of approval.
explanation.definitionFit: Ernie is a boy's name, a pet form of Ernest.

clue.text: A game the French dominate

parts.note: RU is rugby union, a ball game
le is French for the

explanation.surface: The French come to rule a sport.
explanation.definitionFit: To rule over is to govern or hold sway, as dominating does.

clue.text: An honour for Round Table member and legendary outlaw

parts.note: King Arthur's Round Table seated his knights
Robin Hood is the outlaw of English legend

explanation.surface: Arthurian knights and Robin Hood both deserve a royal award.
explanation.definitionFit: A knighthood is a rank conferred by the monarch as a mark of distinction.

clue.text: Fearful noise in train area where people eat

parts.note: a din is a loud, unpleasant noise
to groom is to train or prepare someone

explanation.surface: Loud clatter on the railway around the restaurant car.
explanation.definitionFit: A room set aside for meals in a house.

clue.text: Other ranks provided champagne chiller for the opening

parts.note: OR stands for other ranks, soldiers who are not officers
provided means on condition that, i.e. if
champagne is chilled by being put on ice

explanation.surface: Soldiers get bubbly on ice for a launch party.
explanation.definitionFit: An orifice is a hole or aperture in the body or a container.

clue.text: Almost complete canter one month on sneaky sort of horse

indicators.note: almost tells us to stop one letter short of the full word for the gait

parts.note: a trot is a horse's easy pace, here a full one
Jan is short for January

explanation.surface: A horse nearly finishes its gallop by the end of a month.
explanation.walkthrough: A canter is faster than a trot, so 'complete canter' is a loose pairing of gaits; 'Almost' cuts the final letter and 'on' attaches the month after.
explanation.definitionFit: The Trojan Horse was the hollow wooden horse the Greeks used to trick their way into Troy.

clue.text: Not in favour of previous order for Italian starter

parts.note: anti means against
past means previous, former
O is the abbreviation for order, as in OM, Order of Merit

explanation.surface: Someone opposes the old menu order for the first course.
explanation.definitionFit: Antipasto is the cold first course of an Italian meal.

clue.text: Best clothes, to put fertiliser on?

parts.note: top means best, as in top marks
dress means clothes, as in evening dress

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether their finest outfit is for spreading manure.
explanation.definitionFit: To top-dress soil is to spread manure or compost on the surface.

clue.text: Daughter and son between them have turned mine into trousers

indicators.note: between them have means the two family letters flank the next piece

parts.note: D is the genealogical abbreviation for daughter

indicators.note: turned means the word mine is written backwards

explanation.surface: A family's children convert a mine into a clothing factory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned' gives ENIM, which goes between D and S.
explanation.definitionFit: Denims are hard-wearing cotton jeans.

clue.text: Tedious-sounding game? You need a drink

indicators.note: sounding means the word for tedious is heard, not spelt

parts.note: slow means tedious, dull
gin rummy is a card game, called gin for short

explanation.surface: A boring game will drive you to drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Sloe gin is a liqueur of gin flavoured with blackthorn fruit.

clue.text: Dish of rice: cook to stir on middle of stove

indicators.note: cook in the sense of cook the books, falsify, signals rearranging the letters
middle of picks the central letter of the cooker word

explanation.surface: A recipe telling you to stir the rice on the hob.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cook' rearranges TOSTIR to RISOTT; 'middle of' takes O from stove; 'on' adds it after.
explanation.definitionFit: Risotto is an Italian rice dish cooked slowly in stock.

clue.text: Was a candidate before party manifesto begins to be hit and miss

indicators.note: before means the first piece comes ahead of the rest

parts.note: to run is to stand for election
a do is a party

indicators.note: begins takes the first letter of the policy document

explanation.surface: An election hopeful's campaign is erratic from the start.
explanation.definitionFit: Random means haphazard, without method.

clue.text: Ship's left between two oceans in European anchorage

indicators.note: between means the ship's side lies between the two letters
two means the letter for ocean is written twice

parts.note: O is the abbreviation for ocean
port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: A vessel moored at a harbour between two seas.
explanation.walkthrough: OPORTO is the old English name of Porto, the Portuguese port city.
explanation.definitionFit: Oporto (Porto) is a major harbour city of Portugal.

clue.text: Complete 18 holes to cover start of golf in popular holiday resort

indicators.note: to cover means the phrase for a full course is wrapped round a letter

parts.note: to complete eighteen holes is to play a round of golf

indicators.note: start of takes the first letter of the sport's name

explanation.surface: Golfers finish a round at a busy seaside resort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to cover' wraps the golf phrase round the first letter of 'golf'. A playground is also a place much visited for leisure, as in a rich people's playground.
explanation.definitionFit: A playground can be a place much used for recreation, as in a millionaires' playground.

clue.text: Foreign article contains something untrue

indicators.note: contains means the article holds the other piece inside it

parts.note: an is the indefinite article
a lie is a falsehood

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece from abroad includes a falsehood.
explanation.definitionFit: Alien means strange or from another country.

clue.text: Potato starters for some produce, unfortunately, diarrhoea

indicators.note: starters for means take the opening letter of each following word

explanation.surface: A grim warning that some vegetables can upset the stomach.
explanation.definitionFit: Spud is an informal word for a tuber of the common edible kind.

clue.text: Longing to scratch chapter on information technology

indicators.note: on means, in a down answer, the chapter letters sit below

parts.note: IT is information technology

explanation.surface: Someone is keen to skim a computing textbook chapter.
explanation.definitionFit: An urge to scratch is a tickling irritation of the skin, or a craving.

clue.text: African beast is short money is needed

definitions.meaning: a large horned animal of the savannah, here in short form

explanation.walkthrough: 'is short' tells you the beast's name is clipped (from rhinoceros); 'is needed' links the cash sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a clipped name for the horned rhinoceros and dated slang for money.

clue.text: What delicious food and discriminating people have

definitions.text: What delicious food and discriminating people have

parts.words: What delicious food and discriminating people have
parts.note: the phrase works two ways: food that is pleasant on the tongue, and people with refined judgement

explanation.definitionFit: Tasty food has a pleasing flavour, while a person with refined aesthetic judgement is said to have it too.

clue.text: Mention roughly time required for medication

indicators.note: roughly means approximately arranged, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Someone vaguely recalls when to take their medicine.
explanation.definitionFit: An ointment is a medicinal salve applied to the skin.

clue.text: Pitches create most of the arguments? The reverse is true

indicators.note: most of means drop the final letter of the article

parts.note: rows are noisy quarrels

explanation.surface: Sales pitches stir up disputes, someone claims, then admits the opposite.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue says pitches make 'most of the' + 'arguments', then 'The reverse is true': TH + ROWS make the word for pitches.
explanation.definitionFit: To pitch a ball is to throw it, so pitches are throws.
